description: This file contains unit tests for the ScreenPermissionService class in the OrangeHRM project. The tests verify the behavior of retrieving screen permissions based on user roles, screen definitions, and permission data. It mocks DAOs and sets up various scenarios to ensure correct permission aggregation and retrieval functionality.

classes.name: ScreenPermissionServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the behaviors of ScreenPermissionService, including permission retrieval scenarios and screen fetching.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes a new instance of ScreenPermissionService before each test.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsNoneWithNoScreen
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval when no screen is defined, expecting default permissions to be granted.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsNoneWithScreenDefined
methods.description: Tests permission retrieval when a screen is defined but no permissions exist, expecting all permissions to be false.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsOne
methods.description: Tests retrieval with a single user role permission, verifying correct permission aggregation.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsTwo
methods.description: Tests retrieval with two roles, ensuring permissions are correctly combined.

methods.name: testGetScreenPermissionsMany
methods.description: Tests retrieval with multiple roles, including mixed permission sets, ensuring correct logical aggregation.

methods.name: testGetScreen
methods.description: Verifies that the screen entity is correctly fetched given module and action parameters.

methods.name: verifyPermissions
methods.description: Helper method to assert that the ResourcePermission object has the expected permissions for read, create, update, and delete operations.
